text: {"reasoning":"The assistant provided a complete, on-topic cover letter draft and did not include any effort-related marker such as “You can go figure it out,” “left as an exercise,” or “Get a second agent to do it.” The only additional work offered was: “If you paste the job description (and 2–3 achievements you’re most proud of), I can tailor the letter’s examples and tighten the ‘strategy’ framing,” which is standard follow-up politeness rather than scope expansion or laziness.
